messages:
Anya (CS): Quick heads-up 10k events/day for Sierra Systems' agent. Onboarding health slipped ~12% on knowledge-base queries last 48h. Renewal review in 3w. I'm thinking a low-risk pilot: route FAQ/lookup intents to a compact quantized variant and keep all customer-sensitive or legal intents on the current model. Thoughts? :mag:
Rafael (Platform): We can carve routes by intent + sensitivity tag. We should also enable request-level audit logs for any canary responses and run in their dedicated pool (eu-west-1) to meet data residency. Ops plan: 1% -> 5% -> 10% ramp with metric checks at each step and immediate fallback to standard model on quality alarms.
Nim (ML Eng): Eval summary on Sierra prompts: rdx-core-lite-int8 reduces p95 and cost but shows a ~0.9% drop on our Sierra-specific acceptability rubric; hallucination stable. For legal-scope intents (tagged "legal" or "pii") missrate impact is higher, so exclude those. Recommend: Canary 3% for 72h, nightly eval + daily 6-sample human spot-check, prefix caching for templated prompts, and token-budget fallback >700 tokens.
audit-bot: Canary plan created: 
https://internal.redwood/pilots/sierra-quantized-lookup (internal)
canary-bundle:
  model: rdx-core-lite-int8
  region: eu-west-1
  traffic: 3%
  duration: 72h
  audit_log: enabled
Anya (CS): Need a one-liner I can send to Sierra ops that reassures them about protections.
Nim (ML Eng): Paste: "We're running a short, closely monitored pilot that directs low-risk lookup and FAQ requests to a compact quantized variant in your eu-west-1 pool to improve latency and unit cost; all legal/PII flows remain on the current model and the pilot is auto-gated by nightly quality checks and audit logs."
Rafael (Platform): Routing pseudo-config (draft):
```
routing:
  - match: tag in ["legal","pii","escalation"]
    target: rdx-standard-3
  - match: intent in ["kb_lookup","faq"] AND sensitivity_score < 0.4
    target: weighted(rdx-core-lite-int8:0.03, rdx-standard-3:0.97)
    audit: true
    fallback: rdx-standard-3
```
Anya (CS): Owners: @Nim owns evals & gating thresholds, @Rafael owns routing, audit export and rollout automation, I own customer comms + renewal note. I'll log this in the renewal tracker and schedule a 15m sync with Sierra ops tomorrow 9am CET.
audit-bot: Canary deployed in eu-west-1 at 03:40 UTC, traffic 3%. Dash: https://dash.internal/redwood/sierra/canary (internal)
Anya (CS): Action list: 1) Nim: push nightly eval hook and prepare 6 daily human spot-check samples; 2) Rafael: implement routing & audit export; 3) Me: send customer blurb + schedule enablement. Will post first 24h snapshot here. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
